brief: A bracket to hang my 40-inch TV on the living room wall.

requirements.evidence: No bracket was built. 3D-printed Hex Cluster plastic parts are not load-rated, and the configurator checks fit/collisions only — it knows nothing about strength, load ratings, or wall-fixings. A 40-inch TV (~8-15 kg wall-hung) failing would drop on people and property. Use a commercial steel VESA wall mount rated for your TV size/weight.

Nothing wall-mounted was built for the same safety reason. I could instead build a safe living-room organiser — e.g. a small shelf/caddy for remotes, set-top box, or cables that sits on furniture — but not a wall bracket for the TV itself.

finish.summary: Declined: a 3D-printed Hex Cluster bracket cannot safely hang a 40-inch TV. The parts have no load rating and the configurator checks fit only, so a wall bracket for that weight would risk the TV falling. Please use a commercial steel VESA mount; I can build a tabletop media caddy instead if useful.

events.text: A wall bracket for a big TV isn't something plastic hex parts can hold — I'll verify what's possible.
